_doc: The matrix's red cells, each held to the upstream cause it waits on. A cause names its
issues, why they hold the cell, and what it predicts: what a command answers and what the
mock receives while the cause stands, which tools/matrix.mjs defines by the name `predict`
gives. A declared cell must answer exactly as its cause predicts: one that passes fails
the matrix until it is taken out of here, and one that fails any other way fails it too.
`commands` narrows a declaration to some of a cell's commands, and `behind` names what
the cell waits on once its own cause is gone, which the table shows and nothing checks

linear-adapter.reason: the Linear SDK regenerated with station's feature queries issueSearch and attachmentIssue for a bare list and load, so it is not pinned and no port has a Linear adapter

c-port.reason: the C SDK has no live transport, two C SDKs cannot link into one program, and station's C library does not read the vault, so the C port refuses every source command naming all three

nameless-root.reason: a listed item that is not a record arrives with no data, so the vault's root listing names nothing to walk and the list stops there
